blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – Five individuals were arrested and 41 girls, including 10 minors, were rescued in two simultaneous anti-human trafficking operations conducted by the National Bureau of Investigation Cebu District Office (NBI-CEBDO) in Lapu-Lapu City on Saturday, October 10. The operations were conducted at a resort in Punta Engaño and a private villa in Barangay Pajac following reports that young girls, including minors, were being offered for paid sex through online contacts. Arrested were Emerson Siaton, also known as “Messy” or “Meccy,” in Punta Engaño, and Cristofer Añana Matus, alias “Boyet”; Jicky Benalon Makipig, alias “Jake”; Arjie Barrientos Andrade, alias […]...
